primaryTextRead.text: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which the LORD’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

primaryTextRead.text: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

primaryTextRead.text: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now, LORD God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

primaryTextRead.text: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,

primaryTextRead.text: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:

primaryTextRead.text: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled God’s house.

primaryTextRead.text: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

primaryTextRead.text: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “The LORD has performed his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Then he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house which I have built!

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and to his supplication, LORD my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you;

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “Now therefore arise, LORD God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “LORD God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: But the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Ought you not to know that the LORD, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They burn to the LORD every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of the LORD our God, but you have forsaken him.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Asa did that which was good and right in the LORD his God’s eyes,

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Asa cried to the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, LORD our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. LORD, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They entered into the covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: and that whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

primaryTextRead.text: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, I will say what my God says.”

primaryTextRead.text: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”

primaryTextRead.text: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now therefore let the fear of the LORD be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: and he said, “LORD, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Didn’t you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever?

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: and he said, “Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat. The LORD says to you, ‘Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.

primaryTextRead.text: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the LORD your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。

primaryTextRead.text: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

primaryTextRead.text: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as the LORD has spoken concerning the sons of David.

primaryTextRead.text: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of the LORD’s house to the Baals.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for the LORD the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They abandoned the house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey the LORD’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, he has also forsaken you.’”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and the LORD delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now concerning his sons, the greatness of the burdens laid on him, and the rebuilding of God’s house, behold, they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings. Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: A man of God came to him, saying, “O king, don’t let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel, with all the children of Ephraim.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be struck down?” Then the prophet stopped, and said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: But Amaziah would not listen; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.

primaryTextRead.text: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him prosper.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against the LORD his God, for he went into the LORD’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They resisted Uzziah the king, and said to him, “It isn’t for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the LORD, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。

They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, “Behold, because the LORD, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heaven.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against the LORD your God?

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of the LORD’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked the LORD, the God of his fathers, to anger.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.

primaryTextRead.text: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in the LORD our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, according to the commandment of the king, saying, “You children of Israel, turn again to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Don’t be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against the LORD, the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as you see.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified forever, and serve the LORD your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: For if you turn again to the LORD, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by the LORD’s word.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: who sets his heart to seek God, the LORD, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of the LORD. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings and making confession to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to the LORD their God, and laid them in heaps.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute the LORD’s offerings and the most holy things.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before the LORD his God.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: An arm of flesh is with him, but the LORD our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Doesn’t Hezekiah persuade you to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, ‘The LORD our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria’?

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you out of my hand?”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: His servants spoke yet more against the LORD God and against his servant Hezekiah.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He also wrote letters insulting the LORD, the God of Israel, and speaking against him, saying, “As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall the God of Hezekiah not deliver his people out of my hand.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 2CH32:21は前半で主がアッシリア軍を打つ一方、後半の「彼の神の宮」は帰国したアッシリア王の神を指す。イスラエルの主なる神の用例には含めない。
primaryTextRead.text: The LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, the leaders, and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he had come into the house of his god, those who came out of his own body killed him there with the sword.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him abundant possessions.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: When he was in distress, he begged the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD was God.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He built up the LORD’s altar, and offered sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving on it, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to the LORD their God.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: His prayer also, and how God listened to his request, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the engraved images before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of the LORD his God.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: She said to them, “The LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, you shall tell him this, ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,” says the LORD.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand. The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. All his days they didn’t depart from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to the LORD, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and his people Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in the LORD his God’s sight.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He did that which was evil in the LORD his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the LORD’s mouth.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to the LORD, the God of Israel.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: The LORD, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place;

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until the LORD’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of the LORD’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: They burned God’s house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all of its valuable vessels.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryTextRead.text: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘The LORD, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, the LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.’”
